Lemma
[Sobolev constants under scaling the metric] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0025, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0026 1. ch17:17.2\group Entropy Bounds

For $\lambda >0$, $C_s(\mathcal M,\lambda ^2g)=C_s(\mathcal M,g)$; if $\lambda \ge 1$, then $C(a,\lambda ^2g)\le C(a,g)$.
Proof

\sketch Put $\widetilde g=\lambda ^2g$ and $\widetilde\varphi =\lambda ^{-n/2}\varphi $. The normalized $L^2$ measure is unchanged, while both terms in the defining Sobolev inequality acquire the factor $\lambda ^{-2}$, proving the first identity. The displayed formula for $C(a,g)$, volume scaling, and the first identity prove the second.

□
